brief_rationale: The doctor actively queried the workspace multiple times, obtained existing records, and delivered a detailed plan that included risk triage, medication reconciliation, follow-up, and document resolution. All six responsibility-chain items were met without serious or minor error. The doctor also completed three high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO4) with meaningful trajectory impact by verifying medication instructions, correcting patient misunderstandings about cancer/miscarriage, and dynamically reprioritizing based on symptoms. The closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid; no important non-chain defect is present. This satisfies the Strong boundary and meets the criteria for at least two high-order points, which supports a grade of 5 (Perfect).
